candidates.en: It seems to me that nowadays Americans cannot turn on the television or read a newspaper without seeing the word pop up somewhere as a description of the American demographic.
candidates.zh: 在我看来，如今美国人只要打开电视或翻开报纸，就会在某处看到这个词，用来描述美国的人口构成。

就会在某处看到这个词，用来描述美国的人口构成。
